instruction: Create a native Altium panel from the board file `C:\Users\user\Desktop\wifi_board.PcbDoc` and save it as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\wifi_panel.PcbDoc`. Keep the embedded source board as `WiFi.PcbDoc`. Configure one panel array with 4 rows and 3 columns, `ROWSPACING=1133.8583mil`, `COLSPACING=1338.5827mil`, `MIRROR=TRUE`, and `ORIGINMODE=1`. Add a continuous, closed-loop panel-fabrication route tool path on `MECHANICAL32` using a `10mil` track width that follows all four sides of the panel outline. [Software] To use Altium Designer on Windows, run `D:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE` (adjust if your install path differs).
